system.description: Those with lesser rank are not necessarily lesser. This is one of two Charms of this name — one for heroes (Excellence of the Dutiful Hero) and one for sorcerers. Characters may learn both. Whenever a Terrestrial makes a separate attack as the sorcerer type of special character using any Ability, he may activate this Charm to enhance the action. Doing so improves the attack with the benefits of the unit's Close Combat Rating, Ranged Combat Rating, Close Combat Damage, Ranged Combat Damage and Might as appropriate, applying these bonuses in the same way that they improve the unit's own attacks. This Charm may be placed in a Combo with Charms of other Abilities.
